decisions.reason: Although an accelerator is somewhat peripheral to a machinery maker’s core business, it remains prominently featured and is relatively cheap to carry, so under real-options logic the firm is likely to keep it while its partnership and pipeline value is still unfolding.

The bio-based binder is less directly tied to the firm’s core equipment business, but its continued standalone presentation suggests unresolved upside and the growing, R&D-intensive context supports keeping this option open for another year.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm’s established modular recycling machinery offer and is still highlighted on the homepage, so management would likely retain it because the strategic fit is strong and there is no clear sign that the option has failed.
